At home power the sats usually come to less than the electricity — that's not why people buy it. People buy for the shot at a full block, the sats stacking to their own wallet meanwhile, and the fun of running real Bitcoin hardware.

What do you pay per kWh?

context.pop: Anything I can clear up before you check out?
